description: This source file implements the APIs for device IP configuration and information retrieval, including IPv4 capability, enable/disable status, interface enumeration, and active port counting, for a device management system.

classes.name: hostIf_IP
classes.description: Class managing IP interface information and operations for a device, including interface enumeration, virtual interface handling, and active port counting.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an instance of hostIf_IP for a given device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific hostIf_IP instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Removes and deletes all hostIf_IP instances.

methods.name: getInterfaceName
methods.description: Maps an interface index to its name, including virtual interfaces.

methods.name: getInterfaceNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Counts total IP interfaces (physical + virtual) present on the device.

methods.name: getDevice_IP_Fields
methods.description: Retrieves specific IP-related device information such as IPv4 capability, enable/disable status, and active ports.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for device IP parameters.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests for device IP parameters.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_IPv4Capable
methods.description: Gets whether the device is IPv4 capable.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_IPv4Enable
methods.description: Gets whether IPv4 is enabled on the device.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_IPv4Status
methods.description: Gets the IPv4 stack status ('Enabled' or 'Disabled').

methods.name: get_Device_IP_ULAPrefix
methods.description: Not supported; placeholder for ULA prefix retrieval.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_InterfaceNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of IP interfaces.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_ActivePortNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of active TCP ports.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_IPv4Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables IPv4 on the device.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_ULAPrefix
methods.description: Not supported; placeholder for ULA prefix setting.
